items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: Norman Granz and different people was pulling their hair.

ctx.x: Two years. So it ended up, I came out here. She was making long distance phone calls. I'll give you anything you want, I'll stop, please take me back. No good. Hang up in her face. So from then on, I was on all of her record dates in spite of that, you know.

I mean, she'd take time out between records and go in the ladies room, the powder room to try to get herself together. And she'd be in there an hour, an hour and a half. And the session would eventually run into a double session. We didn't mind that, it was money for us but Norman Granz and different

people was pulling their hair. It was running money out of their pockets. So I found out what was happening to her and I was sniffing cocaine at the time, you know. I had graduated from grass to cocaine. Well cocaine don't let you get greasy and what not, it makes you more concerned with your hygiene and your person, you know, how you look. But you get very paranoid. You can't stand a lot of noise.
